headline: Russia's Rosatom Discusses 100MW Floating Nuclear Power Plants with Africa
summary: Russian state nuclear agency Rosatom is in advanced talks to supply 100-megawatt floating nuclear power stations to four African countries, seeking to expand its specialized marine reactor footprint.
why: Nuclear technology exports represent long-term energy infrastructure partnerships that influence energy security and sovereign balance sheets across emerging markets.

impacts.name: Nuclear Energy
impacts.why: Advanced talks to export floating reactors could unlock multi-billion dollar capital equipment agreements.
